content.content:
===== owners.POST.yml =====
composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# Idempotent create: an optional 'Idempotency-Key' header lets a retried create be safe.
# The first time a key is seen the request proceeds normally (and RecordIdempotency remembers
# the created owner); a repeat with an already-seen key short-circuits to respondExisting,
# returning the originally created owner with 200 instead of validating, running the duplicate
# checks and inserting again. Runs first, before validate binds the body.
checkIdempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckIdempotencyKey
  govern: [ transaction ]
  outputs:
    proceed: validate
    existing: respondExisting

validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerFields
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkCityCapacity

checkCityCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckOwnerCityCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkDailyLimit

checkDailyLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckOwnerDailyLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkIdentity

# Duplicate detection: reject (409) a create whose identityKey (SHA-256 over
# normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)) equals an existing non-deleted owner's.
# The email-domain blocklist has already run in validate. Runs after build (so the owner
# carries its normalized fields) and before save (so a duplicate is a 409, not a record).
checkIdentity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckOwnerIdentityUnique
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHousehold
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHouseholdSize

assignHouseholdSize:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdSize
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignMembershipLevelCap

# Household level ceiling: a new owner joining an existing household has its membership
# level capped at one above the current maximum level among its household members. Runs
# after the household id and size are assigned and before save so the ceiling is computed
# against the pre-existing members and persisted with this owner.
assignMembershipLevelCap:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignMembershipLevelCap
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignMemberId

assignMemberId:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignMemberId
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignNamesakeCount

assignNamesakeCount:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignNamesakeCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignBulkSignupWarning

assignBulkSignupWarning:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignBulkSignupWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignPossibleDuplicate

# Soft-match: after checkIdentity has rejected any exact identity duplicate, flag a new
# owner whose identityKey differs from an existing owner's while its soundex(lastName) and
# postcode match. Runs before save so the flags are computed against pre-existing owners and
# persisted with this one.
assignPossibleDuplicate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignPossibleDuplicate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCapacityWarning

# Approaching-capacity warning: flag a new owner whose city already holds 40-49 owners
# (the hard rejection at 50 has already run in checkCityCapacity). Runs before save so the
# count reflects the pre-existing owners and the flag is persisted with this one.
assignCapacityWarning:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCapacityWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: record

# Associate the Idempotency-Key (if any) with the created owner, so a repeat replays it.
record:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RecordIdempotency
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: notify

# Enqueue a welcome notification: emit a NOTIFY log line carrying the owner id and memberId.
notify:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NotifyWelcome
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

# Idempotent replay: respond 200 with the originally created owner (loaded by checkIdempotency).
respondExisting:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]

content.text:
I've read the full pipeline (`owners.POST.yml` plus every function class it wires). Here is exactly what happens, in order, for `POST /api/owners`. Every step runs inside one transaction (`govern: [ transaction ]`) that commits at the end.

## Gate (before the pipeline)
- **Authorization** — `authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"`. Without that role the request is denied (→ `AuthorizationDeniedException`, 403); nothing below runs.

## 1. `checkIdempotency` — `CheckIdempotencyKey`
- Reads the optional `Idempotency-Key` header (never the body) and **publishes it as a variable**.
- If that key was seen before **and** the original owner still loads, it **short-circuits to `respondExisting`**: re-loads the original owner and returns it with **200** — skipping all validation, duplicate checks and the insert. Otherwise it proceeds.

## 2. `validate` — `ValidateOwnerFields` (the only `@RequestBody` binder)
Validations (all failures collected → `OwnerFieldsInvalidException`, **400**):
- **Required, non-blank:** `firstName`, `lastName`, `city`, `telephone`.
- **Address required** in one form — a non-blank `addressLine1` or a non-blank flat `address`; else `"address"` error.
- **Telephone** must convert to E.164; else `"telephone"` error.
- **Email** (optional): if present, must be syntactically valid **and** its domain not on the disposable blocklist (`mailinator.com`, `tempmail.com`, `guerrillamail.com`); else `"email"` error.
- **Postcode** (optional): if present, must be a 4-digit value valid for the city's region range; else `"postcode"` error.
- **Registration date** (optional): must not be in the future; else `"registrationDate"` error.

Side-effects (mutations written back onto the request, then republished):
- Address normalized/composed into a canonical `address` (structured lines preferred; flat lines cleared appropriately).
- Telephone rewritten to **E.164**.
- Email **trimmed and lower-cased**.
- Postcode **trimmed**.

## 3. `checkCityCapacity` — `CheckOwnerCityCapacity`
- Counts existing owners in the same city (case-insensitive, whitespace collapsed). **≥ 50 → `OwnerCityAtCapacityException`, 409.**

## 4. `checkDailyLimit` — `CheckOwnerDailyLimit`
- Adjusts the effective registration date (supplied or today) to a business day; counts existing owners with that registration date. **≥ 100 → `OwnerDailyLimitExceededException`, 429.**

## 5. `build` — `BuildOwner`
- Maps the DTO to an `Owner` entity; sets `registrationDate = BusinessDay.adjust(effective)` (weekends rolled forward to Monday).

## 6. `checkIdentity` — `CheckOwnerIdentityUnique`
- Computes `identityKey` = SHA-256 over `normalizedTelephone | lowerEmail | soundex(lastName)`. If it equals a **non-deleted** existing owner's key → **`OwnerIdentityConflictException`, 409** (soft-deleted owners ignored).

## 7–14. `assign*` steps — enrichment written onto the entity (no rejection)
7. **`AssignHousehold`** — `householdId` = first 12 hex of SHA-256 over `'V2' | normalizedLastName | postcode`.
8. **`AssignHouseholdSize`** — count of existing owners sharing that `householdId`, **+1** for this one.
9. **`AssignMembershipLevelCap`** — `maxLevel(existing non-deleted household members) + 1` (null if none).
10. **`AssignMemberId`** — `memberId` = `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`, with `-n` (n≥2) appended on collision with an existing memberId.
11. **`AssignNamesakeCount`** — count of existing owners with the same first+last name (case-insensitive).
12. **`AssignBulkSignupWarning`** — `true` when **> 80** owners already exist for this registration business day.
13. **`AssignPossibleDuplicate`** — `possibleDuplicate`/`possibleDuplicateOf` set when a non-deleted existing owner shares `soundex(lastName)` + `postcode` but has a **different** `identityKey` (lowest id wins; null postcode never matches).
14. **`AssignCapacityWarning`** — `true` when the city already holds **40–49** owners.

## 15. `save` — `SaveOwner`
- `ownerRepository.save(owner)` — the **DB insert**; generates the id.

## 16. `record` — `RecordIdempotency`
- If an `Idempotency-Key` was supplied, stores `key → owner.id` in the `IdempotencyStore` so a later repeat replays this owner.

## 17. `audit` — `AuditOwnerCreated`
- Logs on the `AUDIT` logger: a human-readable line (id, memberId, registrationDate, membershipLevel) **and** a JSON `OwnerCreatedEvent` with a monotonic `seq`.

## 18. `notify` — `NotifyWelcome`
- Logs a welcome line on the `NOTIFY` logger (owner id + memberId).

## 19. `respond` — `RespondWithOwnerCreated`
- Sends **201 Created**, `Location: /api/owners/{id}`, body = `OwnerDto`.

**Summary:** the request can be rejected at six points — authorization (403), field validation (400), city capacity (409), daily limit (429), identity conflict (409) — or short-circuited to a 200 replay by idempotency. Everything else is side-effect: request-field normalization, entity enrichment across the eight `assign*` steps, the persist, the idempotency record, and the two log emissions, all committed as one transaction before the 201 response.
